note: What a server sends to show text floating over a unit. The header names the unit.

fields.name: delay
fields.note: A client does not read it.

fields.name: slot
fields.note: Where the text goes. 0 floats it over the unit while the unit is in the client's own view, the text looked up as a key into the client's own text. 1 to 50 writes it, in colour, to that line of a debugging display, only where the unit is the one the player has selected. A client does nothing for any other value.

fields.name: error
fields.note: Nonzero has a client ignore the whole message.

fields.name: colour
fields.note: The text's colour on the debugging display; unread for slot 0.

fields.name: length
fields.note: A client does not read it: it reads the text to its first zero byte, which the text must therefore end with.
